title: 3 Brasseurs
blurb: Guests can enjoy local craft beers brewed on site and a menu featuring Quebecois poutines, Alsatian dishes like choucroutes and Flammekueches, as well as burgers, steaks, and salads. The restaurant is located at the corner of Crescent and Sainte-Catherine streets in Montreal. It offers a warm and convivial atmosphere suitable for dining or casual drinks.
